name: Google Wallet – digital receipts
author: S-ERP
description: Adds an "Add to Google Wallet" button to the digital receipt that customers open by scanning the QR on their receipt. Needs a Google Wallet issuer account (pay.google.com/business/console) and a Google Cloud service account with the Google Wallet API enabled.

config.label: Issuer ID (from Google Pay & Wallet Console)
Service account private key (PEM, from the JSON key file)
Public HTTPS URL of your logo (optional)
